topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: Well, now, that’s a turn of the weather none of us saw coming. Just like the day’s end when the clouds roll in and the light shifts, I suppose we must make do. There’s no use tilling a field when the rain won’t let up, and there’s no sense in fretting over what’s already been left to the saints. Mayhaps, a quiet evening by the hearth, spinning yarn or mending the.Tools. A time to rest and reflect, as the earth does after the harvest. The heart finds its own way to celebrate, even when the skies hold back their brightness.
